usage: Use 林 to mean a grove or a small wooded area. It sounds literary and a bit formal, so it is less common in everyday speech than 森林.
It often appears in place names, scenic descriptions, and written Cantonese/Chinese. For a general “forest” meaning, 森林 is more common.
林 can also be part of compounds and names, where it keeps its nature/woodland feel. In those cases, the exact meaning depends on the whole phrase.
As a noun, 林 can stand alone or be used with measure words like 一片林. It usually refers to a group of trees rather than one single tree.
